note: Research notes have no temporal column (publish_date is text); last_altered is ~2.7 years old — the lastModifiedAt fallback.
Two of three middle-office tables are browse_only — partial namespace lock over multiple tables.
The window end column's whole range precedes the start — venue feed mapped the pair backwards.
The positions snapshot models time as an integer year, newest 2022 — year-column fallback.
record_id duplicates on the keyless snapshot table — replays double-wrote rows.
350 snapshot rows reference closed portfolios — join is by naming convention only.
80 trades reference delisted instruments removed from the master.
90 manager emails are distribution-list names, not addresses.
30 notes carry legacy sequential ids in the uuid column.
'Equity' vs 'EQUITY' — two listing feeds disagree on casing.
15% of counterparties are missing an LEI — smaller entities never registered one and onboarding allowed it through.
Benchmark weights max at 1.6 — percentages stored into a share-of-1 column.
The corporate-actions feed was cut over to a vendor and this table stopped loading ~2.5 years ago.
